high_level_description: stc brand style, two women walking through a bright shopping mall past a wooden sculpture and retail storefronts.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern shopping mall with a curved white glass and steel dome ceiling in a geometric pattern, polished white marble flooring, curved walls, multiple levels of retail spaces, and a decorative brown wooden sculpture in the center.

elements.desc: A woman wearing a black dress, walking through the mall.
A woman wearing a brown abaya and black hijab, walking beside her, both carrying pink and purple shopping bags.
A retail storefront visible in the mall with its brand name displayed.
